description: Keeps the upstream ADE releases named in the Containerfiles current. Renovate only opens pull requests; the Build images workflow builds each affected image, and merging is left to a reviewer.

packageRules.description: T3 Code pins the latest stable release. Nightlies stay a manual switch, so do not follow the nightly dist-tag.
prBodyNotes: The `t3` npm package installs a launcher that downloads the matching runtime from the GitHub release on first start. Check that the release is published before merging.

packageRules.description: OpenChamber 2.x drives the OpenCode 2.x CLI, so review the two together even though they version independently.
OpenClaw tags images with calver plus -amd64 and -arm64 variants, so only accept the bare dated tags.
Paseo publishes beta tags next to releases. Keep to released versions.
Keep base images on their current major. Node 22 vs 24 is a deliberate choice per editor, and UBI 9 is pinned by the platform.
Orca is built from a release tarball that orca/web-client.patch is rebased against.
prBodyNotes: `orca/web-client.patch` is applied on top of this tag, so watch the Orca build in the Build images workflow before merging.

packageRules.description: bubblewrap is compiled from source in vs-code-agent-host/Containerfile.
prBodyNotes: bubblewrap is built from source with meson in `vs-code-agent-host/Containerfile`, so watch the vs-code-agent-host build before merging.

customManagers.description: OpenCode CLI version installed alongside OpenChamber
Orca release tag. The tarball URL interpolates ${ORCA_VERSION}, and entrypoint.sh exports the same value to the standalone runtime, so both declarations must move together.
